name: wargus
title: Wargus
description: Wargus Stratagus PAX port; converted Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness assets stay on SD.
about: Verified ESP32-P4 build of the Wargus Stratagus port. The native menus and first mission path have been exercised on hardware. Requires a complete data tree converted from your original Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness files; game data is not included. Full-campaign, save-state and all-control coverage is not certified.
changelog: 0.1.3: make Guichan widget cleanup idempotent; verified startup and clean exit on the AIO.
controls: Mouse or touch: select units and use the game menus
Hold Menu 3 s: return to the launcher

requires.note: Complete converted Warcraft II data tree
PAX video pack generated from extracted PC movie files
Complete converted Warcraft II data tree
PAX video pack generated from extracted PC movie files

extract.instructions: HOST COMPUTER REQUIRED: wartool is not an ESP32-P4 program. On Linux, use your own Warcraft II Battle.net Edition data and build/run the upstream wartool extractor using the steps in pax-modules/upstream/retroesp32/GUS_GAME_RECIPES.md (Recipe 3). Add the matching stock scripts/maps, prepare audio, and run prepare_warcraft_videos.py on the output to create media/menu.paxmenu. Copy the complete prepared tree to /sd/roms/wargus/ and keep that movie pack at /sd/roms/wargus/media/menu.paxmenu. Recipe PAX only creates the SD folders and shows instructions; it does not run wartool. An ISO or archive by itself is not prepared runtime data. Hardware testing covers menu/startup and the first mission path; full-campaign, save-state, and all-control coverage is not certified.
